characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Askeladden is a young, wiry male of average height with an unkempt appearance that reflects his humble beginnings. He has scruffy brown hair and curious brown eyes that sparkle with mischief and intelligence. His clothing is simple and worn, consisting of earth-toned, patched-up tunic and trousers, fitting for a peasant. Often seen carrying a large wooden kneading trough, Askeladden has an endearing, determined demeanor, always ready to tackle new challenges. He's usually depicted in outdoor settings like forests or near the royal palace, emphasizing his connection to nature and his ingenuity.

characters.name: Troldet
characters.description: Troldet is a massive and menacing figure with a hulking build, covered in coarse, earthy skin resembling a rugged boulder. His features are exaggerated and grotesque, with sharp tusks protruding from his maw, bulging eyes that glow maliciously, and a mane of wild, tangled hair. Dressed in tattered, moss-covered rags, he embodies the menacing nature of the forest. Troldet is often portrayed near the lake or in his mountain dwelling, surrounded by his gold and silver treasures, which he fiercely guards.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: Kongen is an authoritative figure of regal bearing, with a tall, stately build and an aura of command. His hair and beard are white, suggesting wisdom and age, and his facial features are kind but firm. He wears opulent royal attire - a rich robe of deep blues and purples adorned with gold and jewels, and a crown that sparkles atop his head. The King is typically seen within the lavish settings of the royal palace, reflecting his power and the wealth of his kingdom.

characters.name: Trolddatteren
characters.description: Trolddatteren appears unexpectedly youthful and unassuming compared to her monstrous father. She has delicate features with pale skin, long, flowing black hair, and sharp, cautious eyes. Her attire consists of simple, earthy garments that blend with her surroundings in the mountain dwelling, suggesting a life lived in shadows. Despite her gentle appearance, she carries an air of danger, hinting at her loyalty to the troll family and their riches.
